newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PacMags sees slightly higher profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PacMags sees slightly higher profit.

text.p: Pacific Magazines and Printing Ltd said on Tuesday that it believed 1996/97 profits would be slightly above last year.
"I think it is fair to say it will be marginally up on this current year we have just finished," chairman Ken Cowley told reporters after the company's annual meeting.

Cowley told shareholders in his speech that lower paper prices, growth in earnings from publishing, and a drive to cut costs would underpin an improved performance for the group in the next two years.
The company, which is about 45 percent owned by News Corp Ltd, suffered a fall in 1995/96 net profit to A$58.04 million from A$64.44 million in 1994/95.
Operating profit rose slightly to A$90.38 million from A$89.55 million.
